definitions.gloss: final settlement of accounts; overall accounting
definitions.explanation: The comprehensive closing of all accounts at the end of a fiscal period, covering all transactions.
A figurative comprehensive review or final assessment of a period of effort, a series of events, or an entire endeavor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{総決算|そうけっさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We conduct the final settlement of accounts at the end of the year.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{総|そう}→総〜：03958_sou⟧ (overall, total) and ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧ (settlement of accounts). Originally an accounting term, it is widely used figuratively to mean a comprehensive review or final assessment of any endeavor.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総決算|そうけっさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to conduct a final reckoning
- {総決算|そうけっさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to do a summing-up
- ⟦{一年|いちねん}→一年：10994_ichinen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総決算|そうけっさん}: a year-end review
- ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{総決算|そうけっさん}: a life's final reckoning

USAGE:
In business, this is a formal accounting term. In everyday usage, it often appears at year-end or at the conclusion of a long project, career, or era to describe looking back and evaluating the whole.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧: settlement of accounts — the base word, for regular accounting periods
- ⟦{総括|そうかつ}→総括：13877_soukatsu⟧: summary, overview — similar figurative use but emphasizes summarizing rather than settling
